graph/description:
**Why is half the protein tolerant?** Each residue's AlphaFold confidence (pLDDT) against the mean AlphaMissense score of its 19 possible changes.

Residues AlphaFold can't place (pLDDT $< 50$) are **disordered**: there is no fold to break, so almost any change is predicted benign, and ClinVar's pathogenic changes (red rings) sit in the folded core.

*Be aware:* disorder is not junk. p53's disordered ends carry its activation and binding sites, whose damage neither AlphaMissense nor a fold sees well.

**Click** a residue to show it in 3D.
